entities.name: Nikahin_App_Core
observations: Nikahin is an all-in-one Flutter standalone mobile application for wedding planning (Android & iOS).
Spun off and evolved from the Wedding Planner module of TrackIt (Kotlin/Compose) into an independent cross-platform Flutter app.
Repository: rivaldiekaptrrr/nikahin_app, workspace located at c:/Rivaldi/nikahin_app.
Follows an Offline-First architectural pattern with Drift SQLite as the local single source of truth.
UI language and user-facing strings are strictly in Indonesian with Bento Grid and Material 3 design system.

entities.name: Nikahin_Tech_Stack
observations: Framework: Flutter (SDK ^3.8.0) & Dart 3.
State Management: Flutter Riverpod.
Database: Drift (SQLite) + sqlite3_flutter_libs for offline-first data persistence.
Routing & Navigation: GoRouter.
Documents & Export: pdf, printing, and share_plus for A4 Wedding Guidebook PDF and CSV guest list exports.
Security: local_auth for Biometric (Fingerprint/Face) and PIN lock protection.
Key-Value Storage: shared_preferences for user settings, theme modes (Light/Dark/System), and reminders.
In-App Updater powered by package_info_plus, open_filex, and GitHub Releases REST API.
CI/CD Dual-Platform workflow on GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/multiplatform-build.yml) supporting automated APK releases from git tags (v*) and internal main builds.

entities.name: Nikahin_Features_Catalog
observations: Dashboard & Countdown: Interactive D-day countdown timer, custom romantic quotes with typography styling, quick summary cards for budget, tasks, and documents.
Budget & Payment Terms: Itemized expense tracking (Venue, Catering, MUA, Dokumentasi, Seserahan, dll.) with milestone payment terms (Belum Bayar, DP Terbayar, Lunas).
Vendor Management: Vendor directory with PIC contact, contract value, and payment progress.
Guests & RSVP: Guestbook with classification (Keluarga CPP/CPW, Teman CPP/CPW, VIP, Umum), session targeting (Akad, Resepsi, Keduanya), pax counter, and CSV export for reception desk.
Rundown Timeline: Multi-event chronological timeline (Lamaran, Pengajian, Siraman, Akad Nikah, Resepsi) with visual timeline nodes and assigned PIC per session.
Documents Checklist: Legal KUA & Catatan Sipil administrative document checklist for CPP & CPW with deadline auto-sorting.
Seserahan & Committee: Hantaran/gift items status tracking (Belum Beli, Dibeli, Sedang Dihias, Siap) and committee roles with family fabric/uniform allocations.
PDF Guidebook Export: Full A4 printable wedding guidebook report generator with auto-pagination and clean table layout.
In-App Updater: Automatic silent background check on startup and manual check button in Settings with download progress bar and direct APK installation trigger.
Release Notes Generator: Automatic extraction of RELEASE_NOTES.md content to GitHub Releases.

entities.name: Nikahin_Architecture_Structure
observations: lib/app: App entry point, MaterialApp configuration, theme mode provider, and GoRouter definitions.
lib/data: Local Drift SQLite database tables, DAOs, Firestore REST remote sync handlers, and repository layer.
lib/domain: Domain models, entities, and business logic enums.
lib/features: Feature-first module structure (auth, budget, committee, dashboard, documents, guests, profile_select, rundown, seserahan, settings, tasks, vendors).
lib/shared: Common utility helpers (currency/date formatters, PDF/CSV generators) and reusable UI widgets (Bento Card, Guide Dialogs, Pickers).
lib/ui/theme: Color palettes (Light/Dark/System), typography, and Bento Grid UI tokens.

entities.name: Nikahin_CI_CD_Release_Workflow
observations: Project Nikahin uses an automated Dual-Platform CI/CD workflow on GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/multiplatform-build.yml).
GOLDEN RULE: Always run local validation (flutter analyze, flutter test, flutter build apk --release) BEFORE pushing to GitHub or tagging releases.
Push to master/main triggers internal artifact build (app-nikahin-main.apk) without creating public release.
Pushing version tag (v*, e.g., v1.0.0) automatically generates a GitHub Release with APK asset and uses RELEASE_NOTES.md as changelog.
Platform toggles are managed centrally via lib/app/config/platform_config.dart and the platform-flags job in multiplatform-build.yml.
Skill file stored locally in .agents/skills/flutter-cicd-release-workflow/SKILL.md.

entities.name: Nikahin_Environment_Setup
observations: Standard environment: Flutter SDK 3.47.6+ (Dart ^3.13.5) on stable channel at C:/src/flutter.
Java JDK: Eclipse Adoptium / Temurin JDK 17 (JAVA_HOME).
Android SDK: C:/Android/sdk with Android SDK Platforms 36/35, Build-Tools 36.0.0/35.0.0, Android NDK r28c (28.2.x), CMake 3.22.1.
Environment variables: JAVA_HOME, ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, and PATH containing flutter/bin, platform-tools, cmdline-tools/latest/bin.
Project initialization: flutter pub get, followed by mandatory Drift SQLite generation: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs.
Validation pipeline: flutter analyze (0 errors), flutter test (51 tests passed), flutter build apk --release.
